title: Airy Auburn Polish Steak Dumplings
description: A traditional Polish dish featuring lean minced steak and a dairy-free friendly recipe, these dumplings are a delicious meal prep option. The briny and glassy-jelly texture is achieved through a lamination-puff process.
instructions: Combine the minced steak, salt, black pepper, onion powder, and garlic powder in a bowl and mix well.
Add the egg replacement and mix until just combined.
Gradually add the flour and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 12 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Use a rolling pin to flatten each ball into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of the steak mixture in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the filling and press the edges together to seal the dumpling.
Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the dumplings for 10 minutes.
Remove the dumplings from the water and serve with a dairy-free friendly topping.
